title: Share, Grow, Lead
content: USANA provides an opportunity to earn immediate income through product sales and expand your earning potential as your vision grows.

title: Understanding the Ecosystem
content: Before building your business, you must understand the core components of the USANA Compensation Plan.

cards.title: Business Center
cards.body: A virtual store your online transactions are processed through. It's the center of your business-building activity where sales points accumulate.

cards.title: Sales Points
cards.body: The reward value assigned to each product. Personal Sales Points come from your purchases; Group Sales Points come from your team's network.

cards.title: Commission Points
cards.body: Group sales points calculate commission points. One commission point equals US $1, converted into your local currency.

cards.title: Binary Tree
cards.body: The core structure. Brand Partners introduce customers and partners, and sales points flow up this tree to accumulate in Business Centers.

title: Immediate Income
content: Make USANA products part of your daily life and earn by sharing your experiences.

cards.title: Retail Sales
cards.body: Purchase products at the Preferred Price (10% discount) and resell them at a price you choose to earn retail profit.

cards.title: New Sales Bonus
cards.body: Earn a 10% bonus on the sales points generated by your new Brand Partners or Preferred Customers for their first 6 months.

cards.title: Subscribe & Save
cards.body: Sign up to get an additional 10% discount on all products, on top of the Preferred Price.

cards.title: Milestone Bonuses
cards.body: In your first 13 weeks: Earn 50 commission points for 250 sales points (Milestone 1), 100 commission points for 500 sales points across 4 enrollees (Milestone 2), and 150 points for hitting Pacesetter (Milestone 3).

title: Building a Team
content: Expand your reach by inviting others to join you. You earn a 20% commission on the group sales points from the smaller side of your Business Center.

cards.title: The Binary Tree
cards.body: Your Business Center has a left and right side. Commissions are based on the lesser of the two sides. Unpaid extra points (up to 5,000) carry over indefinitely.

cards.title: 1 vs 3 Business Centers
cards.body: Start with 1 BC by generating 200 personal sales points, or open 3 BCs by generating 400 personal points within your first 13 Fridays.

cards.title: Commission Qualified
cards.body: Maintain 100 personal sales points every 4 weeks to keep 1 BC active, or 200 points to keep multiple BCs active.

cards.title: Maxing & Reentries
cards.body: When a BC reaches 5,000 points on both sides, it 'maxes' at 1,000 commission points. Doing this allows you to place new 'reentry' Business Centers deeper in your organization.

title: Pacesetter & Matching Bonus
content: Set a strong pace in your first 13 weeks to unlock lifetime matching bonuses.

cards.title: Pacesetter Requirements
cards.body: Within 13 weeks: Sell 1,600 points, enroll 4 Brand Partners who activate their BC, and retain them so they remain commission-qualified for 8 consecutive weeks.

cards.title: The Matching Bonus
cards.body: As a Pacesetter, receive a 10% match of the weekly commissions earned by Brand Partners you enrolled who also become Pacesetters.

cards.title: Annual Requalification
cards.body: To maintain your Matching Bonus, you must complete the three Pacesetter requirements each year within 13 weeks of your enrollment anniversary.

title: Advance and Reward
content: Rise through the ranks based on your weekly commission points, from Sharer (50 points) to Diamond Director (4,000 points for four consecutive weeks).

cards.title: Leadership Bonus
cards.body: A weekly bonus pool equaling a percentage of global group sales points, paid to leaders who qualify by maxing at least one BC and meeting retention metrics.

cards.title: Elite Bonus
cards.body: A quarterly regional bonus pool distributed exclusively to the top income earners who meet specific team growth and sales metrics.
